profile_convention: (h,s,q,F): Hamilton paths; paths starting at root; H after deleting root; ordered two-slot spanning covers with first nonempty path ending at root, second path possibly empty. H(empty)=1.
scope: All roots of all labelled tournaments orders1..3, plus regularC5 and adaptive H37 order6; k1..3 and every new mark. Direct subset/end recursion counts all four profile coordinates. This finite check is separate from the all-order combinatorial proof.
